text:
maria: Anyone else seeing outbound timeouts from sidecared pods in eu-west1? model-pull jobs failing with 504/timeout when talking to our model-storage bucket.
kevin: yup noticed a spike ~10:12 UTC. Pod logs show TLS handshake errors followed by EGRESS_TIMEOUT in Envoy.
ryan: saw increased connection churn on the NAT instance, looks like ephemeral ports are getting saturated. tagging @maria
maria: hmm. we rolled the sidecar policy update this morning (restricting outbound to 0.0.0.0/0 -> via egress-gateway). Could the egress gw be the bottleneck?
kevin: possible. The gateway is on a small nodepool; autoscaler didn't kick because LB healthchecks are failing.
olivia: logs from egress-gateway show many connections in CLOSE_WAIT and a lot of 502s back to the sidecars. Also conntrack is at 95%.
sre-bot: deploybot: canary rollout for sidecar-egress-policy finished at 09:58 UTC.
ryan: quick check: netstat on gateway shows local port range consumed: `tcp 0 0 10.0.12.8:xxxxx` lots of ephemeral ports.
maria: if it's SNAT port exhaustion, options: increase ephemeral port range on NAT, add more NAT instances, or enable connection reuse/keepalive from sidecars.
kevin: sidecars should be reusing keepalives but we also introduced a proxy-per-request path for model pulls in the policy change which might force new connections.
olivia: rolling back the policy for one deployment reduced errors immediately — confirmed on staging.
ryan: also noticed iptables MASQUERADE rule was overwritten on gateway after a bot update, changed conntrack timeout values. suspect two things: policy + gateway misconfig.
maria: action items: 1) revert canary fully until we patch connection reuse (done for the affected deploy) 2) escalate to infra to add one more gateway node + bump conntrack/ephemeral ports for gateway 3) add healthcheck retries on LB so autoscaler sees healthy.
kevin: adding a quick mitigation: probing to open longer keepalives from worker sidecars (5m) and disable proxy-per-request for model pulls.
olivia: filed infra ticket: INFRA-4921 with logs and conntrack dumps, assigned to @ryan. link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INFRA-4921
ryan: I'll follow up with NAT metrics and schedule a capacity bump in eu-west1 later today. For future: we should have an egress capacity runbook.
maria: thanks all — leaving thread open for updates. :thumbsup:
